preSQLs:['delete T
FROM
(
SELECT *
, DupRank = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY [Exam Key], [Status Code]
              ORDER BY [Stat Date] desc
            )
  FROM [dev].[AzureSqlCOREStageStep2]
) AS T
where DupRank>1'],

, DupRank = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY [Exam Key],[Status ID]
              ORDER BY [Data Pull Date] desc
            )

) AS T
where DupRank>1'],
